items.name: token_subject
items.source:
pub fn token_subject(token: &str) -> Result<String, AnyError> {
    token_claim(token)?
        .get("sub")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .map(str::to_string)
        .ok_or_else(|| "router run token has no subject to revoke".into())
}
